rawFindings.title: Post asset paths now stop resolving against the public URL base
rawFindings.explanation: `pathFn.join(post.path, this.slug)` treats `post.path` as a filesystem path, not a URL path. For a post whose permalink is `/foo/` and an asset slug containing a space, `path.join('/foo/', 'file with space')` produces `/foo/file with space`, but for a post path that is a full URL or contains a protocol (for example `http://example.com/foo/`), `path.join` drops the protocol and returns an invalid path. This changes `PostAsset.path` from a URL-safe resolver to a platform-dependent filesystem join.
rawFindings.suggestion: Keep using URL resolution for `PostAsset.path` or otherwise construct the asset URL with a URL-aware join that preserves the scheme and host while still avoiding escaping only the asset slug.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: If `post.path` is `http://example.com/foo/` and `slug` is `bar`, `PostAsset.path` now becomes `http:/example.com/foo/bar` on POSIX instead of `http://example.com/foo/bar`, so generated asset URLs are broken.
